lesson.concept: The maximum of a sin(expression) occurs when the sin part equals 1, not when x equals a number. Set the expression inside the bracket to 90 + k.360, or the sin term equal to 1.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

example.problem: Find the maximum value of sin x cos x
work: Use the double angle: sin x cos x = 0.5 sin 2x.

probe.problem: Find the maximum of 2 cos x.

learner_message: The maximum occurs when the sin (or cos) part equals 1, not when x equals a particular number.
